Dabba Garam is the brainchild of four bachelors who were on a hunt for affordable homely meals in the midst of a crowded city.
Our mission is to provide nutritious, cost-effective meals for all. Cooked with freshly sourced ingredients, the food items are devoid of preservatives and frozen food items. To put it simply, at the core it's Ghar ka khana, ranging around different meals, courses, and cuisines to suit your taste buds.
Keeping in mind the times we live in, our meals are delivered through zero contact for your safety and well-being. Dabba Garam kitchen currently serves in areas of Mumbai, Thane, and Navi Mumbai and we continue to grow daily.

featured_reviews.name: Shruti Mane
featured_reviews.review_text:
I am extremely disappointed with the service and quality of my recent order. I had specifically ordered Tadka Dal Khichdi, but instead I received plain/normal Dal Khichdi. This is not a small mistake because customers order specific items based on taste and preference, and receiving the wrong item completely ruined the meal experience.
What made the situation even worse was the shocking hygiene issue. While eating, I found a hair in the food. This is absolutely unacceptable and highly unhygienic. Food preparation should follow basic cleanliness standards, and finding hair in a meal raises serious concerns about the kitchen hygiene and quality checks followed by your restaurant.
I trusted your service expecting good quality food and proper attention to orders, but this experience was extremely frustrating and disappointing. Not only was the order incorrect, but the hygiene issue made the food impossible to eat further. It felt like there was no proper care taken while preparing or packing the order.
As a paying customer, I expect:
Correct items to be delivered
Proper quality checks before dispatch
Hygienic food preparation standards
Better attention to customer satisfaction
This experience has completely affected my trust in your service. I hope you take this complaint seriously, improve your kitchen hygiene, and ensure such careless mistakes do not happen with other customers in the future. I would also expect an appropriate resolution/refund for this unpleasant experience.

featured_reviews.name: Note from Travelam
featured_reviews.review_text:
Visiting the Mumbai Dabbawala collection point near the railway station was one of the most fascinating experiences of my Mumbai trip. Watching thousands of lunch boxes being sorted, grouped, and dispatched with remarkable precision was truly impressive.

Our guide explained the entire system in detail, from the collection of home-cooked meals to the complex sorting process and their timely delivery across the city. What amazed me most was how this world-famous network operates with such efficiency, accuracy, and coordination, largely without the use of advanced technology.

The dedication, discipline, and teamwork of the Dabbawalas are inspiring. Seeing this unique logistics system in action gave me a whole new appreciation for the people who keep Mumbai moving every day. A highly recommended experience for anyone visiting Mumbai and wanting to understand the city’s incredible work culture and spirit.
